objective.name: response
objective.description: Provider-agnostic contract of a successful inference result returned by this LLM context.

output._format_comment: Effective representation of the generated output.
output._content_comment: Generated content. Its concrete representation follows the effective output format. With native tools, content is null when the model called tools instead of answering.
output._tool_calls_comment: Present only when the model called native tools: a list of {id, name, arguments}, in the provider's order. It is a captured model decision, never an executable request: the arguments are untrusted until the MCP gateway validates them.
output._assistant_content_comment: Present for a request with native tools: the assistant turn as canonical blocks (text, tool_call, provider_block), exactly what must be sent back as the assistant message of the next request. An answer with neither text nor tool call, an unsupported block or a tool call cut by the token limit is an error, never empty content.

resolved._provider_comment: Provider that actually executed the inference.
resolved._model_comment: Model that actually executed the inference.

usage._input_tokens_comment: Number of input tokens reported for the inference when available.
usage._output_tokens_comment: Number of generated tokens reported for the inference when available.
usage._cached_input_tokens_comment: Optional. Part of input_tokens served from the provider prompt cache when the provider reports it; input_tokens still counts the whole context.
usage._cache_creation_input_tokens_comment: Optional. Part of input_tokens written to the provider prompt cache by this inference when the provider reports it (the new prefix); input_tokens still counts the whole context. What is neither read nor written is the uncached input.

functional._finish_reason_comment: Provider-normalized indication of why generation terminated.
functional._duration_ms_comment: Total inference duration observed by the LLM wrapper when available.
